# Package manager knowledge base

The facts depgate relies on, each linked to the official documentation or changelog it was verified against.

Legend: ↗ source · ❓ uncertain (official sources are incomplete) · ⚠️ disputed (official sources disagree; every variant is shown) · `1.2.3+` means "from version 1.2.3".

7 tools · 262 facts · 35 uncertain · 14 disputed · verified 2026-10-28 to 2026-10-29.

## Notes

Context recorded with verified facts.

### npm

- `cooldown.configFiles`: Any npm config layer works: project .npmrc (read only at the project root and not for global installs), ~/.npmrc, the global npmrc, npm_config_min_release_age or the CLI. package.json cannot set it. [↗](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v12/configuring-npm/npmrc)
- `cooldown.unit`: Type is null or Number; 0 turns the delay off. Fractional days are not documented. [↗](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v12/using-npm/config#min-release-age)
- `cooldown.default`: Unchanged in npm 12. [↗](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v12/using-npm/config#min-release-age)
- `cooldown.securityUpdates`: npm audit fix keeps the vulnerable version, warns that the fix was blocked (since 11.18.0) and exits non-zero. Add the package to min-release-age-exclude or relax the delay. [↗](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v12/using-npm/config#min-release-age)
- `installScripts.allowList.file`: Only the root package.json counts; allowScripts in dependencies is ignored. npx, npm exec and global installs use the allow-scripts config instead. [↗](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v12/commands/npm-install-scripts)
- `installScripts.disableAll`: Default false. Overrides allowScripts and dangerously-allow-all-scripts. npm run/test/start still run the named script, but not its pre/post scripts. [↗](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v12/using-npm/config#ignore-scripts)
- `sources.git.values`: root allows only git dependencies listed in the project package.json. [↗](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v12/using-npm/config#allow-git)
- `sources.remoteTarball.values`: Tarballs on the configured registry hostname are always allowed. The 2026-05-22 GitHub changelog mentions only all and none; the config reference also lists root. [↗](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v12/using-npm/config#allow-remote)
- `sources.file.values`: The 2026-05-22 GitHub changelog mentions only all and none; the config reference also lists root. [↗](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v12/using-npm/config#allow-file)
- `sources.file.default`: npm 12 did not change the default. [↗](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-06-09-upcoming-breaking-changes-for-npm-v12/)
- `sources.directory.values`: The 2026-05-22 GitHub changelog mentions only all and none; the config reference also lists root. [↗](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v12/using-npm/config#allow-directory)
- `sources.directory.default`: npm 12 did not change the default. [↗](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v12/using-npm/config#allow-directory)
- `project.lockfiles`: npm 11 and earlier prefer npm-shrinkwrap.json over package-lock.json when both exist; npm 12 no longer reads or writes npm-shrinkwrap.json (same format, rename it). [↗](https://github.com/npm/cli/blob/v12.2.1/docs/lib/content/configuring-npm/package-lock-json.md)
- `project.workspaces`: An array of folder paths or globs. [↗](https://github.com/npm/cli/blob/v12.2.1/docs/lib/content/configuring-npm/package-json.md#workspaces)
- `extra.lockfileFormat`: Entries under packages: resolved is the registry tarball URL, the git URL with its commit (git+ssh://… or git+https://…#sha), file:<path> for local tarballs and directories, or the link target when link is true. hasInstallScript marks a preinstall, install or postinstall script (prepare scripts of non-registry sources are not flagged). npm tells registry tarballs from other URLs with the registryTarball pattern (workspaces/arborist/lib/install-scripts.js), so a tarball URL on a registry host looks like a registry package. [↗](https://github.com/npm/cli/blob/v12.2.1/docs/lib/content/configuring-npm/package-lock-json.md)
- `extra.npmrcScope`: Only the .npmrc at the root of the project npm runs in is read. Inside a workspace package npm moves the prefix to the workspace root (using-npm/workspaces.md) and warns "ignoring workspace config" for the package .npmrc (workspaces/config/lib/index.js). [↗](https://github.com/npm/cli/blob/v12.2.1/docs/lib/content/configuring-npm/npmrc.md)
- `extra.npmrcListSyntax`: Array values are written by adding [] after the key, one line per value, e.g. min-release-age-exclude[]=@myorg/*. [↗](https://github.com/npm/cli/blob/v12.2.1/docs/lib/content/configuring-npm/npmrc.md)
- `extra.allowAllScripts`: Boolean, default false: runs every dependency install script whether or not allowScripts approves it; --ignore-scripts still wins. First present in the 11.16.0 definitions. [↗](https://github.com/npm/cli/blob/v12.2.1/workspaces/config/lib/definitions/definitions.js)
- `extra.excludeWildcards`: min-release-age-exclude takes package names or minimatch globs from its first version. [↗](https://github.com/npm/cli/blob/v12.2.1/workspaces/config/lib/definitions/definitions.js)
- `extra.latestVersion`: Marked as the latest GitHub release on 2026-10-28; the 11.x line is still maintained (11.21.1). [↗](https://github.com/npm/cli/releases/tag/v12.2.1)

### pnpm

- `cooldown.configFiles`: pnpm-workspace.yaml (or the global config.yaml) works in every version that has the setting. pnpm 10 also reads minimum-release-age from .npmrc; pnpm 11+ reads only auth and registry settings from .npmrc and ignores the package.json "pnpm" field. [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/releases/tag/v11.0.0)
- `cooldown.unit`: Integer number of minutes, e.g. 1440 = 1 day; no duration strings. [↗](https://pnpm.io/settings/dependency-resolution)
- `cooldown.default`: The built-in 1440 is non-strict: pnpm adds immature versions to minimumReleaseAgeExclude instead of failing (see strictMode). [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm.io/blob/main/versioned_docs/version-11.x/settings/dependency-resolution.md)
- `cooldown.securityUpdates`: No setting bypasses the delay. Since 11.0.0, pnpm audit --fix adds the minimum patched version of each advisory to minimumReleaseAgeExclude (since 11.22.0 only while it is still inside the window). [↗](https://pnpm.io/cli/audit)
- `installScripts.defaultPolicy`: Unreviewed builds only warn in pnpm 10; strictDepBuilds is true by default since 11.0.0, so they fail the install. Prepare scripts of git-hosted dependencies are blocked since 10.26.0. [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/releases/tag/v10.0.0)
- `installScripts.allowList.setting`: Replaced onlyBuiltDependencies, which was removed in 11.0.0 (see legacyAllowList). Since 12.11.0, permissions.<package>.build takes precedence over allowBuilds. [↗](https://pnpm.io/settings/build)
- `installScripts.disableAll`: Default false; --ignore-scripts on the CLI. Also skips the project’s own scripts. [↗](https://pnpm.io/cli/install)
- `sources.git.setting`: Blocks git repositories and tarball URLs for transitive dependencies only; no setting blocks them as direct dependencies. [↗](https://pnpm.io/10.x/settings)
- `sources.remoteTarball.setting`: Blocks git repositories and tarball URLs for transitive dependencies only; no setting blocks them as direct dependencies. [↗](https://pnpm.io/10.x/settings)
- `project.workspaces`: Globs with ! exclusions. Without packages only the root is in the workspace; pnpm still reads settings from the file in single-package projects. pnpm ignores workspaces in package.json. [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm.io/blob/main/versioned_docs/version-10.x/pnpm-workspace_yaml.md)
- `extra.lockfileFormat`: lockfileVersion 9.0 (pnpm 9 to 12). Registry packages are keyed name@version; git dependencies name@git+<repo>#<commit> with resolution type git, or a tarball from a git host (gitHosted: true; older lockfiles lack the flag, so the host decides); tarball URLs name@https://…; local tarballs name@file:….tgz; local directories have resolution type directory; link: and workspace: dependencies appear only under importers. requiresBuild was removed in lockfile v9, so install scripts are not recorded. [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/blob/v10.34.9/lockfile/types/src/index.ts)
- `extra.npmrcPrecedence`: pnpm 10 applies pnpm-workspace.yaml settings over .npmrc and npm_config_* variables; command-line options win over both (same order on v10.16.0). The 10.18.3 changelog says pnpm config set --location=project writes to pnpm-workspace.yaml "matching read priority". The 10.x docs do not state the order. [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/blob/v10.34.9/config/config/src/index.ts)
- `extra.sharedWorkspaceLockfile`: Same name and default in pnpm 11 and 12, where it is read only from pnpm-workspace.yaml. [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm.io/blob/7aded9fe30ceb31d4302b4189fcac84c958582b0/versioned_docs/version-10.x/workspaces.md)
- `extra.ignoredSince`: Structured form of npmrcIgnored: from 11.0.0 on, other .npmrc settings and the package.json "pnpm" field have no effect. [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/releases/tag/v11.0.0)
- `extra.allowAllBuilds`: Boolean, default false; packages denied in allowBuilds stay blocked. [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm.io/blob/main/versioned_docs/version-10.x/settings.md)
- `extra.excludeWildcards`: Globs such as @myorg/* in minimumReleaseAgeExclude since 10.17.0. [↗](https://pnpm.io/10.x/settings)
- `extra.onlyBuiltDependencies`: The allow-list before allowBuilds: package.json pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies, also pnpm-workspace.yaml since 10.5.0; removed in 11.0.0 (see legacyAllowList). [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm.io/blob/main/versioned_docs/version-11.x/settings/build.md)
- `extra.latestVersion`: pnpm 12.0.0 shipped on 26 Aug and 11.0.0 on 28 Apr (GitHub shows no year; 2026 inferred from release order). 11.x and 10.x still receive patches. [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/releases/tag/v12.16.1)
- `extra.strictDepBuilds`: When true, an unreviewed dependency build script fails the install. [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/releases/tag/v11.0.0)
- `extra.strictMode`: In non-strict mode pnpm silently writes immature picks into minimumReleaseAgeExclude. Strict mode fails CI installs with ERR_PNPM_NO_MATURE_MATCHING_VERSION. [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/releases/tag/v12.3.0)

### Yarn (Berry)

- `cooldown.configFiles`: Also YARN_NPM_MINIMAL_AGE_GATE (general YARN_ env rule) and, since 4.17.0, npmScopes.<scope>.npmMinimalAgeGate. package.json cannot set it. [↗](https://yarnpkg.com/configuration/yarnrc)
- `cooldown.unit`: Bare numbers are minutes. Since 4.11.0 duration strings with ms, s, m, h, d or w (e.g. 3d, 1w) also work; on 4.10.x a string such as 7d silently had no effect. [↗](https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/pull/6942)
- `installScripts.defaultPolicy`: Workspace scripts still run. Upgraded projects with an old lockfile get enableScripts: true written to .yarnrc.yml. Yarn 1 runs scripts unless --ignore-scripts is passed. [↗](https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/releases/tag/%40yarnpkg%2Fcli%2F4.14.0)
- `installScripts.allowList.file`: Root package.json only; ignored inside workspaces. [↗](https://yarnpkg.com/configuration/manifest#dependenciesMeta)
- `installScripts.disableAll`: Set in .yarnrc.yml; the default since 4.14.0. yarn install --mode=skip-build skips builds for one run. Berry ignores YARN_IGNORE_SCRIPTS. [↗](https://yarnpkg.com/configuration/yarnrc#enableScripts)
- `sources.git.default`: Upgraded projects with an old lockfile get ["**"] written to .yarnrc.yml. [↗](https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/blob/master/packages/docusaurus/static/configuration/yarnrc.json)
- `project.lockfiles`: Yarn Classic uses the same name; see berryLockfileMarker and classicLockfileHeader to tell them apart. [↗](https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/blob/master/packages/yarnpkg-fslib/sources/path.ts)
- `project.workspaces`: Array of folder glob patterns. [↗](https://yarnpkg.com/configuration/manifest#workspaces)
- `extra.lockfileFormat`: Each entry has resolution: name@<locator>: npm:<version> for the registry, <repository>#commit=<sha> for git (GitHub shortcuts become https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git), an http(s) URL for tarballs, file:<path> (a .tgz or .tar.gz path is a tarball, anything else a directory), portal: and link: for directories, workspace: for workspace packages, and patch: around the URL-encoded original locator. No field records install scripts; dependenciesMeta.built: false is a user opt-out. [↗](https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/blob/@yarnpkg/cli/4.18.1/packages/yarnpkg-core/sources/Project.ts)
- `extra.durationStrings`: npmMinimalAgeGate accepts a number followed by ms, s, m, h, d or w (e.g. 3d, 1w) since 4.11.0; on 4.10.x such a string silently had no effect. [↗](https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/pull/6942)
- `extra.excludeWildcards`: Name globs such as @scope/* or package* in npmPreapprovedPackages. [↗](https://yarnpkg.com/configuration/yarnrc#npmPreapprovedPackages)
- `extra.classicLockfileHeader`: Written as # yarn lockfile v${LOCKFILE_VERSION} with LOCKFILE_VERSION = 1 (src/constants.js). [↗](https://github.com/yarnpkg/yarn/blob/master/src/lockfile/stringify.js)
- `extra.latestVersion`: Yarn 6 is still in preview. [↗](https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/releases/tag/%40yarnpkg%2Fcli%2F4.18.1)
- `extra.upgradeMigration`: Explicit values written by depgate prevent the migration. [↗](https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/pull/7135)

### Bun

- `cooldown.configFiles`: Also the global $HOME/.bunfig.toml or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/.bunfig.toml; local keys override global ones. Bun’s .npmrc support has no min-release-age key. [↗](https://bun.com/docs/runtime/bunfig)
- `cooldown.cliFlag`: bun install, add and update; bunx honours it only since 1.4.4. [↗](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/bun-v1.3.0/docs/cli/install.md)
- `cooldown.unit`: Plain numbers are seconds; 0 turns it off. Since 1.4.4 duration strings such as 90m, 12 hours, 3d or 2 weeks also work (the bunfig reference still documents seconds only). [↗](https://bun.com/docs/runtime/bunfig#install-minimumreleaseage)
- `cooldown.exclude.patternSyntax`: Since 1.4.4 --minimum-release-age-excludes replaces the bunfig list for one command. [↗](https://bun.com/blog/bun-v1.4.4#minimumreleaseage-supports-units-and-per-version-exclusions)
- `installScripts.defaultPolicy`: Dependency scripts run only for Bun’s built-in trusted list (npm-registry packages only since 1.4) or trustedDependencies; the root project’s scripts run. First version of this policy not tracked. [↗](https://bun.com/docs/pm/lifecycle#trusteddependencies)
- `installScripts.allowList.setting`: Replaces the built-in default list rather than extending it. bun pm trust and bun add --trust write it. [↗](https://bun.com/docs/pm/lifecycle#trusteddependencies)
- `installScripts.disableAll`: Default false. Also --ignore-scripts or ignore-scripts=true in .npmrc. Skips the project’s own scripts and trustedDependencies too. [↗](https://bun.com/docs/runtime/bunfig#install-ignorescripts)
- `project.workspaces`: Full glob syntax, including ! patterns. [↗](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/pm/workspaces.mdx)
- `project.workspacesObjectKey`: The object form also holds catalog and catalogs. [↗](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/pm/catalogs.mdx)
- `extra.lockfileFormat`: bun.lock (text, the default since 1.2) maps each package to a tuple starting with name@<spec>: name@<version> followed by the registry for npm, name@git+<repo>#<sha> and name@github:<owner>/<repo>#<sha> for git, name@https://… for tarball URLs, name@./x.tgz (without file:) for local tarballs, name@file:<dir> and name@link:<dir> for directories, name@workspace:<dir> for workspace packages. The info object carries hasInstallScript: true only since 1.4.4, with no lockfileVersion change, so a missing flag proves nothing for older files. bun.lockb is an undocumented binary format. [↗](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/bun-v1.4.4/src/install/lockfile/bun.lock.rs)
- `extra.durationStrings`: Since 1.4.4 minimumReleaseAge also takes duration strings such as 90m, 12 hours, 3d or 2 weeks; plain numbers stay seconds. [↗](https://bun.com/blog/bun-v1.4.4#minimumreleaseage-supports-units-and-per-version-exclusions)
- `extra.excludeWildcards`: minimumReleaseAgeExcludes takes exact package names (and name@version since 1.4.4), no wildcards. [↗](https://bun.com/blog/bun-v1.4.4#minimumreleaseage-supports-units-and-per-version-exclusions)

### Deno

- `cooldown.setting`: A number or string, or the object form { "age": ..., "exclude": [...] }. Covers npm and JSR packages. [↗](https://docs.deno.com/runtime/reference/deno_json/#minimum-dependency-age)
- `cooldown.configFiles`: min-release-age in .npmrc since 2.8; also NPM_CONFIG_MIN_RELEASE_AGE. This page does not state precedence; denoland/deno#35458 gives CLI flag, deno.json, .npmrc, environment, built-in default. [↗](https://docs.deno.com/runtime/packages/supply_chain/#minimum-dependency-age)
- `cooldown.cliFlag`: Alias --min-dep-age since 2.9.3. deno install honours it since 2.5.5; deno add, deno remove and deno x since 2.9.4. [↗](https://docs.deno.com/runtime/reference/deno_json/#minimum-dependency-age)
- `cooldown.unit`: Numbers are minutes; strings may be an ISO-8601 duration (P3D, PT72H), an absolute date or an RFC3339 timestamp; 0 turns it off. The .npmrc format differs (see npmrcFormat). [↗](https://github.com/denoland/deno/blob/v2.9.8/cli/schemas/config-file.v1.json)
- `cooldown.default`: Since 2.9 a 24-hour minimum applies when nothing is configured; set 0 to turn it off. Whether the default covers JSR is not stated. [↗](https://docs.deno.com/runtime/reference/deno_json/#minimum-dependency-age)
- `cooldown.exclude.patternSyntax`: Before 2.9.2 wildcard entries were stored literally and never matched. No CLI flag or .npmrc key for exclusions. [↗](https://github.com/denoland/deno/blob/v2.9.8/cli/schemas/config-file.v1.json)
- `installScripts.defaultPolicy`: npm lifecycle scripts run only when approved, and only with a node_modules directory. deno x / dx runs them after its download prompt is accepted. [↗](https://docs.deno.com/runtime/reference/cli/install/)
- `installScripts.allowList.setting`: deno approve-scripts writes it. --allow-scripts=npm:pkg on the CLI exists since 1.45. [↗](https://deno.com/blog/v2.6#granular-control-over-postinstall-scripts-with-deno-approve-scripts)
- `installScripts.allowList.file`: Must be set at the workspace root. [↗](https://docs.deno.com/examples/npm_lifecycle_scripts_tutorial/)
- `sources.git.setting`: git+https: and git+ssh: dependencies are not supported in package.json. [↗](https://docs.deno.com/examples/local_unpublished_packages_tutorial/#what-is-not-supported)
- `sources.remoteTarball.setting`: Tarball URL dependencies are not supported in package.json. [↗](https://docs.deno.com/examples/local_unpublished_packages_tutorial/#what-is-not-supported)
- `sources.file.setting`: No setting. Since 2.8 file: and link: entries are silently skipped (scope disputed, see fileLinkSkipped); deno.json "links" overrides dependencies with local packages. [↗](https://docs.deno.com/examples/local_unpublished_packages_tutorial/#what-is-not-supported)
- `sources.directory.setting`: No setting; local directories behave like file: and link: entries (see fileLinkSkipped). [↗](https://docs.deno.com/examples/local_unpublished_packages_tutorial/#what-is-not-supported)
- `project.lockfiles`: The default location; lock.path in deno.json can move it and "lock": false turns it off. [↗](https://github.com/denoland/docs/blob/main/runtime/reference/deno_json.md)
- `project.workspaces`: Paths of members; globs and ! exclusions since Deno 2.1. [↗](https://github.com/denoland/docs/blob/main/runtime/fundamentals/workspaces.md)
- `extra.lockfileFormat`: deno.lock version 5 (the default since Deno 2.3) marks npm packages with lifecycle scripts as scripts: true (hasInstallScript from the registry or a preinstall, install or postinstall script, libs/npm/resolution/graph.rs); version 4 has no such field. tarball is written only for registries other than the default one. Deno rejects git and http(s) dependencies in package.json and keeps file: dependencies out of the lockfile. [↗](https://github.com/denoland/deno/blob/v2.9.8/libs/lockfile/printer.rs)
- `extra.durationStrings`: Strings are ISO-8601 durations (P3D, PT72H), an absolute date or an RFC3339 timestamp; the last two set a fixed cut-off instead of a delay. [↗](https://github.com/denoland/deno/blob/v2.9.8/cli/schemas/config-file.v1.json)
- `extra.ageObjectKey`: In the object form of minimumDependencyAge, age holds the delay and exclude the exemptions. [↗](https://github.com/denoland/deno/blob/v2.9.8/cli/schemas/config-file.v1.json)
- `extra.excludeWildcards`: A trailing * matches by prefix (npm:@scope/*) since 2.9.2; earlier wildcard entries never matched. [↗](https://github.com/denoland/deno/blob/v2.9.8/cli/schemas/config-file.v1.json)
- `extra.npmSpecifierPrefix`: Exclusions and allowScripts entries name npm packages as npm:<name>. [↗](https://github.com/denoland/deno/blob/v2.9.8/cli/schemas/config-file.v1.json)
- `extra.allowAllScripts`: allowScripts: true allows every npm lifecycle script. [↗](https://github.com/denoland/deno/blob/v2.9.8/cli/schemas/config-file.v1.json)

### Renovate

- `cooldown.setting`: Formerly stabilityDays; old configs are migrated to "N days". Can be scoped with packageRules, vulnerabilityAlerts and update types. [↗](https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/#minimumreleaseage)
- `cooldown.configFiles`: Searched in this order. The "renovate" key in package.json still works but is deprecated. Shared presets (extends) can also set it. [↗](https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/)
- `cooldown.cliFlag`: Self-hosted CLI only; environment variable RENOVATE_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE. [↗](https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/#minimumreleaseage)
- `cooldown.unit`: For example "3 days" or "14 days". Since 42.19.5 "0 days" is treated like null. [↗](https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/minimum-release-age/)
- `cooldown.availableSince`: Earlier versions had the same feature as stabilityDays (first version not tracked). [↗](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/releases/tag/35.46.0)
- `cooldown.default`: Off unless configured; the docs table shows no default. config:best-practices adds "3 days" for npm (see presets). Since 44.96.0 minimumReleaseAgeBuffer adds 30 minutes once a delay is set. [↗](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/blob/main/lib/config/options/index.ts)
- `cooldown.exclude.setting`: No dedicated exclusion list. [↗](https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/minimum-release-age/#how-do-i-opt-out-dependencies-from-minimum-release-age-checks)
- `cooldown.exclude.patternSyntax`: Glob and regex patterns since 38.0.0. [↗](https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/#matchpackagenames)
- `cooldown.securityUpdates`: The vulnerabilityAlerts defaults set minimumReleaseAge to null; a delay can still be set inside vulnerabilityAlerts. [↗](https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/minimum-release-age/#what-happens-to-security-updates)
- `installScripts.defaultPolicy`: Renovate disables package manager scripts when it updates lockfiles; the Mend-hosted app never runs them. [↗](https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/#ignorescripts)
- `installScripts.disableAll`: The default; the self-hosted global allowScripts also defaults to false. [↗](https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/#ignorescripts)
- `extra.durationStrings`: Values such as "3 days" or "1 hour", parsed by toMs (lib/util/pretty-time.ts). [↗](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/blob/main/docs/usage/key-concepts/minimum-release-age.md)
- `extra.minimumReleaseAgePresets`: config:best-practices extends security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm, which sets minimumReleaseAge "3 days" for the npm datasource (see presets). [↗](https://docs.renovatebot.com/presets-security/#securityminimumreleaseagenpm)
- `extra.excludeRule`: The documented opt-out: a packageRules entry with matchPackageNames and minimumReleaseAge: null. [↗](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/blob/main/docs/usage/key-concepts/minimum-release-age.md)
- `extra.securityUpdatesSetting`: The vulnerabilityAlerts default sets minimumReleaseAge to null, so security updates skip the delay unless a value is set there. [↗](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/blob/main/lib/config/options/index.ts)
- `extra.excludeWildcards`: matchPackageNames accepts globs (and regex) since 38.0.0. [↗](https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/#matchpackagenames)
- `extra.ruleDescription`: A human-readable description allowed inside any configuration object; depgate uses it to recognise the packageRules entry it manages. [↗](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/blob/main/docs/usage/configuration-options.md#description)
- `extra.packageJsonConfig`: Deprecated: the configuration options page warns that support may be removed, and Renovate logs that using package.json is deprecated. [↗](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/blob/main/lib/workers/repository/init/merge.ts)
- `extra.durationUnits`: Units shown in the docs: minimumReleaseAge=1 hour on this page and "3 days" in the configuration options. The value is parsed by toMs (lib/util/pretty-time.ts), whose tests also accept 1 day, 1 week and combined values. [↗](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/blob/main/docs/usage/key-concepts/minimum-release-age.md)
- `extra.missingTimestamp`: minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour was added in 41.150.0; timestamp-optional still fails open. [↗](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/releases/tag/42.0.0)
- `extra.independentOfPackageManager`: Source code passes --before to npm only; pnpm, Yarn and Bun gates are not read. [↗](https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/minimum-release-age/)

### Dependabot

- `cooldown.setting`: Per updates entry: default-days, semver-major-days, semver-minor-days, semver-patch-days, include, exclude. The semver-* keys apply only to SemVer ecosystems. [↗](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/dependabot-options-reference#cooldown)
- `cooldown.configFiles`: On the default branch. [↗](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/concepts/supply-chain-security/about-the-dependabot-yml-file)
- `cooldown.unit`: Integer days; the allowed range is disputed (see dayRange). [↗](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/dependabot-options-reference#cooldown)
- `cooldown.availableSince`: GA date on github.com; NuGet and Helm since 2025-07-29. [↗](https://github.blog/changelog/2025-07-01-dependabot-supports-configuration-of-a-minimum-package-age/)
- `cooldown.default`: Version updates wait 3 days even without a cooldown block (GHES from 3.23); default-days is also 3 when cooldown is set without it. [↗](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-07-14-dependabot-version-updates-introduce-default-package-cooldown/)
- `cooldown.securityUpdates`: Cooldown exists only for version updates. dependabot-core also passes a zero age to npm, pnpm and Yarn for security updates, overriding repository gates. [↗](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/dependabot-options-reference#cooldown)
- `installScripts.allowList.setting`: insecure-external-code-execution: allow exists only for bundler, mix and pip; nothing allows npm, pnpm, Yarn or Bun scripts. [↗](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/dependabot-options-reference#insecure-external-code-execution)
- `extra.cooldownKeys`: Keys inside the cooldown block of an updates entry. [↗](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/dependabot-options-reference#cooldown)
- `extra.excludeWildcards`: cooldown.exclude accepts * wildcards. [↗](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/dependabot-options-reference#cooldown)
- `extra.ecosystems`: The npm ecosystem covers npm, pnpm and Yarn; bun needs Bun 1.1.39 or later and deno needs Deno 2. Cooldown is supported for all three. [↗](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/dependabot-options-reference#package-ecosystem)
- `extra.maximumDays`: The page says the number of cooldown days must be between 1 and 90; whether 0 is accepted is disputed (see dayRange). [↗](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/tutorials/secure-your-dependencies/optimizing-pr-creation-version-updates)

### Environment

- `corepack.packageManagerField`: Format name@x.y.z, optionally followed by +<hash algorithm>.<hash>; a URL to a .js or .tgz file is also allowed. setup-bun also reads bun@x from this key. [↗](https://github.com/nodejs/corepack/blob/main/README.md)
- `corepack.devEnginesSince`: Limited support at first; since 0.36.0 Corepack uses the devEngines.packageManager range when packageManager is missing. [↗](https://github.com/nodejs/corepack/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- `corepack.envFileSince`: Corepack reads COREPACK_* keys from .corepack.env; since 0.36.0 only the closest file. COREPACK_ENV_FILE=0 turns it off. [↗](https://github.com/nodejs/corepack/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- `corepack.bundledWithNode`: Node.js 25.0.0 stopped distributing Corepack; the Corepack README says it ships with Node.js from 14.19.0 up to (but not including) 25.0.0. [↗](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V25.md)
- `devEngines`: Each entry is an object or a list of objects with name (required), version and onFail (warn, error by default, or ignore). Corepack and the setup actions read it too. [↗](https://github.com/npm/cli/blob/v12.2.1/docs/lib/content/configuring-npm/package-json.md#devengines)
- `devEnginesSince`: npm version that introduced devEngines. [↗](https://github.com/npm/cli/blob/v10.9.0/CHANGELOG.md)
- `volta.manifest`: Also extends: a path to another JSON file with a volta key. pnpm support is experimental and needs VOLTA_FEATURE_PNPM=1. [↗](https://github.com/volta-cli/volta/blob/main/crates/volta-core/src/project/serial.rs)
- `volta.maintained`: The README says Volta is unmaintained and recommends migrating to mise. [↗](https://github.com/volta-cli/volta/blob/main/README.md)
- `asdf.toolVersionsFile`: One tool per line followed by one or more versions separated by spaces (fallbacks); # starts a comment. [↗](https://github.com/asdf-vm/asdf/blob/master/docs/manage/configuration.md)
- `asdf.plugins`: Short names in the asdf plugin index; there is no plugin named node. [↗](https://github.com/asdf-vm/asdf-plugins/tree/master/plugins)
- `githubActions.setupNode`: Current major v7. node-version-file reads package.json, .nvmrc, .node-version, .tool-versions or mise.toml; node-version wins when both are set. [↗](https://github.com/actions/setup-node/blob/main/action.yml)
- `githubActions.pnpmActionSetup`: Current major v6. Without version the action reads devEngines.packageManager or packageManager from package.json (package_json_file). [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/blob/master/action.yml)
- `githubActions.pnpmSetup`: For pnpm 11 and later. Without version it reads devEngines.packageManager or packageManager; runtime takes <name>@<version> for node, bun or deno. [↗](https://github.com/pnpm/setup/blob/main/action.yml)
- `githubActions.setupBun`: Current major v2. Without bun-version it reads packageManager (bun@x), then engines.bun, then installs latest. [↗](https://github.com/oven-sh/setup-bun/blob/main/action.yml)
- `githubActions.setupDeno`: Current major v2. deno-version defaults to 2.x; deno-version-file reads .dvmrc or .tool-versions. [↗](https://github.com/denoland/setup-deno/blob/main/action.yml)
- `githubActions.codeScanningUpload`: The example workflow on this page needs security-events: write in every repository and actions: read with contents: read only in private ones. The inputs come from upload-sarif/action.yml in github/codeql-action (current major v4, v4.39.1 checked); category tells analyses of the same tool and commit apart. [↗](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/how-tos/find-and-fix-code-vulnerabilities/integrate-with-existing-tools/upload-sarif-file)

## To review

Uncertain facts rest on incomplete official sources; disputed facts have official sources that disagree.

### npm · `installScripts.defaultPolicy` ⚠️ disputed

npm 12 blocking dependency scripts is undisputed. For npm 11.16-11.21 the install-scripts command page says scripts are blocked by default, while the v11 config reference, the 11.16.0 pull request and the GitHub changelog say unreviewed scripts still run with a notice.

- Variant 1: earlier: `run`<br>11.16.0+: `run-with-warning`<br>12.0.0+: `deny-except-allowlist` · [source](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/using-npm/config#strict-allow-scripts), verified 2026-10-28. npm 12 also blocks implicit node-gyp builds and prepare scripts of git, file and link dependencies.
- Variant 2: earlier: `run`<br>11.16.0+: `deny-except-allowlist` · [source](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/commands/npm-install-scripts), verified 2026-10-28.
